The NORTH ATLANTIC OSCILLATION has turned negative in recent days bringing colder temperatures and more heating demand to Northwest Europe. The NAO measures the pressure differential between the area of high pressure normally found around the Azores and the low pressure normally located near Iceland and Greenland. Higher-than-average differentials accelerate the polar front jet stream and keep cold air bottled up in the High Arctic. Lower-than-average differentials cause the polar front jet to slacken and meander, and can allow salients of cold air to escape and penetrate into lower latitudes in the Northeast United States and Northwest Europe. NAO is an atmospheric rather than oceanic phenomenon so cycles are much shorter and more unstable than El Niño and the Southern Oscillation (ENSO). The recent slackening and meandering of the polar front jet has brought a mass of cold air into Northwest Europe and much lower temperatures, overwhelming the background warmth from a strong El Niño in the Pacific:

For the first time in four years, not a single very large crude carrier, or VLCC, entered the US Gulf of Mexico to collect an oil cargo last week, Port of Corpus Christi Chief Executive Officer Kent Britton said in an interview with Bloomberg News on Thursday.

The supertanker market has been in disarray since the US-Iran conflict stranded scores of vessels around the Persian Gulf and prompted others to sail circuitous routes to avoid the war zone. The German energy ministry has prepared draft legislation that would allow coal and oil-fired power plants in the grid reserve to participate temporarily in the open market, sources in government circles have told Argus.

The return to the open market of 7.45GW of coal-fired and 805MW of oil-fired reserve capacity would only be possible in the event of a gas shortage, namely if the level is raised to "alarm" or "emergency" status, according to the draft document — dated 16 October — seen by Argus.

Any return would be temporary, with the document stating that plants' participation in the open market would end by 31 March 2028, although this is not yet confirmed.
